description: This file contains platform-specific functions for OpenWrt, handling image checks, upgrades, and configuration copying based on board types.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the image is compatible with the current platform based on board name.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade procedure specific to board type.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies platform-specific configuration based on board type.
